quiz.title: Charlotte's Web Task
quiz.subject: English

concepts.definition: Understanding a character's feelings and actions
A sequence of drawings that tell a story

quiz.notes: After reading Chapters 1-15 of Charlotte's Web, select and complete 4 out of the 6 tasks from the choice board that best show your understanding of the text.
successCriteria: I can analyze a character's feelings and actions
I can create a comic strip to tell a story
I can collect and define interesting vocabulary words

questions.question: Choose a character (Wilbur, Fern, or Charlotte) and draw the outline of their character. Inside the outline, write feelings and talk about the character.
questions.hint: Think about what the character is feeling and what they might say
questions.solution: Choose a character and draw their outline. Inside the outline, write words or phrases that describe the character's feelings and thoughts.
questions.diagramDescription: A comic strip panel with a character outline

questions.question: Outside the outline, write actions and behavior from Chapters 1-15
questions.hint: Think about what the character does and how they behave
questions.solution: Write words or phrases that describe the character's actions and behavior outside the outline.
questions.diagramDescription: A comic strip panel with a character outline

questions.question: Add speech bubbles and captions to the comic strip
questions.hint: Think about what the character might say and what the captions might describe
questions.solution: Add speech bubbles and captions to the comic strip to tell a story.
questions.diagramDescription: A comic strip panel with a character outline

questions.question: Select 2 interesting words from each of the chapters and find their meanings
questions.hint: Choose words that you don't know or find interesting
questions.solution: Read through the chapters and select 2 interesting words from each chapter. Find their meanings and write them down.

questions.question: Create a sentence using each of the selected words
questions.hint: Think about how you can use the words in a sentence
questions.solution: Write a sentence using each of the selected words.

tasks.title: Task: Book-to-Life Point of View Switch

questions.question: Rewrite a short scene from a different character's perspective
questions.hint: Choose a scene and think about how a different character might see it
questions.solution: Choose a scene from the book and rewrite it from a different character's perspective.

questions.question: Explain how it connects to Charlotte's plan to save Wilbur
questions.hint: Think about how the scene relates to Charlotte's plan
questions.solution: Explain how the rewritten scene connects to Charlotte's plan to save Wilbur.

questions.question: Create a newspaper page with a headline about Wilbur
questions.hint: Think about what the headline might say
questions.solution: Create a newspaper page with a headline about Wilbur.

questions.question: Write one opinion column about Charlotte's plan
questions.hint: Think about what you think about Charlotte's plan
questions.solution: Write an opinion column about Charlotte's plan.

questions.question: Add an illustration or ad to the newspaper page
questions.hint: Think about what the illustration or ad might look like
questions.solution: Add an illustration or ad to the newspaper page.
